title: Apply online for a planning certificate
summary: Learn how to apply online for a section 10.7 planning certificate (zoning certificate) to understand controls and restrictions on a property.
intro:
A section 10.7 planning certificate (zoning certificate) provides information on any controls, requirements and restrictions that may apply to how a property is used or how a parcel of land can be developed.

The certificate is issued by your local council. You can apply online through the NSW Planning Portal, either:

### Information in the certificate

You can choose from 2 options when you request a planning certificate.
what_you_need: MyServiceNSW Account or NSW Planning Portal login details
Payment for NSW Planning Portal service fees

how_to_steps.text: Check that NSW Planning Portal online applications are accepted by your local council.
Select ‘Log in with a Service NSW account’ or enter your NSW Planning Portal login details.
Follow the prompts to complete your application, either:

faqs.a: A section 10.7 planning certificate provides information on any controls, requirements, and restrictions that may apply to how a property is used or how a parcel of land can be developed.

faqs.q: Where is the planning certificate issued?
faqs.a: The certificate is issued by your local council.

faqs.q: What do I need to apply online?
faqs.a: You need your MyServiceNSW Account or NSW Planning Portal login details, and payment for NSW Planning Portal service fees.
